title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
reason: First crypto firm acquiring an EU bank is a significant, sourced infrastructure and licensing milestone for the industry.

sources.summary: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
reason: Chainalysis research quantifying AI-agent crypto payments at scale is a sourced adoption milestone squarely at the AI-Bitcoin intersection.

sources.summary: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China’s 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.
